title: stylosanthes gracilis var. subviscosa
intro: Stylosanthes gracilis var. subviscosa, commonly known as the stick-tight, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in the tropical regions, for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in treating various ailments such as fever, wounds, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Stylosanthes gracilis var. subviscosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its traditional uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
